label: Fires on the token immediately before the word 'empire(s)' is completed - the first piece ' em'/' Emp'/' им' of a split empire word, or the adjective/determiner right before a whole-token ' Empire' - when the model predicts that lexeme next (cross-lingual; weaker for 'emperor'); only weakly (~0.1 of max) on the ' em'/' им' piece in other words, and not on imperial topic as such.

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit

notes: Probes support H1 (next-token prediction of 'empire'; fractions of max 764): Russian ' им'|пер|ии after Российской 0.71; ' Roman' before whole-token ' Empire' 0.529; business 'rival media em|pires' 0.472 (peak ' em'; no polity, so topic is irrelevant); ' Ottoman' before ' Empire' 0.408; colonial ' Emp'|ires 0.369; 'four great empires' 0.344 but peak on the final '.', so ' em' in a plain historical frame scored < 0.344 (corpus ' em'|pires 0.74-0.83); Korean 로마 제국 0.266 (peak not on '마'); ' em'|per|ors 0.236 (emperor covered, weaker). Token reading refuted, weak residual: ' em'|por|ium 0.101, ' им'|ид|ж 0.077. Meaning reading refuted: 'imperial authority' 0.069, 'late republic, the Roman Senate' 0.061 (peak ' Roman'; republic frame suppresses), Kingdom of Poland 0.018, Tudor 0.002. Hazard: 'the Ottoman state' 0.26 at ' Ottoman' - imperial adjectives fire before their noun; ' Roman' is used only in a republic frame. - pole (max 130): same axis, ' the'/' young' before duke/king/prince. Fire set: 2x ' em'|pires (one business), 1x ' Emp'|ires, 2x single-token adjective before ' Empire' (Roman, Persian; Mongol dropped: 'ol' is a word-final piece, only analogue Korean 0.266), 2x Russian ' им'|пер, 1x ' em'|per|ors after 'child'. Near misses: kingdoms/Grand Duchy/the Roman state/boy king/papers, Russian neuter 'обширное княжество' (gender excludes империя), word-piece controls ' em'|irs after 'ruled by local' and ' им'|уществ|а; splits tokenizer-verified.
